title: Layer 3D
notes: Editorial selection, independent of repository activity or star counts. Claims and screenshot checked against the public README on 2026-10-23: https://github.com/naiplawan/layer-3d#readme (docs/screenshots/hero.png). The outcome describes implemented functionality, not measured adoption or impact.
description: A Thai-language website for a Bangkok 3D-printing studio, from material selection to a LINE quote request.
problemStatement: Customers need to understand the printing options and find a clear way to request a quote.
solution: A responsive service website with material comparisons, project examples and an interactive 3D printer preview.

value.contribution: Built the Next.js page, interactive printer scene and service-to-quote flow, including Thai typography and mobile layouts.
value.designDecision: Load the 3D scene separately, pause it outside the viewport and respect reduced motion so the illustration does not need to run continuously.
value.outcome: Visitors can compare materials, browse sample work and continue to LINE to request a quote from the same page.
value.screenshotAlt: Layer 3D website with Thai service information, quote buttons and an interactive printer preview
value.screenshotCaption: Desktop landing page and its interactive printer preview.
